risks.title: Early-stage mining exploration dependency
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned at the beginning of the text as central (exploration stage mining company with no history of operations). The language is strong (no commercially mineable ore body), trend is stable, and it represents a fundamental risk to the business model.

risks.title: Competition for permit acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions risks related to competition in the mining sector and mineral property acquisition. The language is moderate but recurring, and the geopolitical context (Kazakhstan) amplifies the risk intensity.

risks.title: Political instability in Kazakhstan
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly cited (risk of political and economic instability in Kazakhstan), with strong language and a central position among specific risks. It is stable in trend and crucial for on-site operations.

risks.title: Dependency on local communities
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the importance of relationships with local communities (our success depends on developing and maintaining relationships). The language is assertive, the risk is structural and stable, impacting social license to operate.

risks.title: Joint venture-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Multiple mentions of risks related to option and joint venture agreements (joint venture agreements, risks associated with joint ventures), with precise and repeated language. Risk is stable and key for financing and development.

risks.title: Environmental and social activism
risks.score_rationale: The text specifically cites risks related to social and environmental activism. The language is direct, the risk exists within a context of increasing regulation, and represents a threat to permits and reputation.

risks.title: Information systems cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The risk is briefly mentioned (risks relating to information systems and cybersecurity), without elaboration. Language is generic but present, within a category of growing importance, trend is stable.

risks.title: Permit and authorization acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly cites risks related to obtaining and maintaining permits (our ability to obtain required permits, timing of receipt). Language is strong, the risk is central to operations, within an unstable regulatory context, trend is stable.
